rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action makes little or no noise.

example.english: I read quietly at night because I don't want to disturb anyone.
example.traditional: 夜晚我靜靜地睇書，唔想嘈到人。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 ngo5 zing6 zing6 dei6 tai2 syu1 m4 soeng2 cou4 dou3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when someone does something secretly or without drawing attention, rather than merely making little noise.

example.english: They quietly took my bag of chips away.
example.traditional: 佢靜雞雞咁拎走咗我包薯片。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zing6 gai1 gai1 gam2 ling1 zau2 zo2 ngo5 baau1 syu4 pin2
